manual.note: Shared anatomical H=216 at2x is approved, excluding topknot/strands. Main-cap crown, eye line and anatomical shoulders require landmark review before normalization; current bun may exceed available headroom. Whole-alpha heights are diagnostic only. This observation does not waive production proportion requirements or any hard gate.

Anatomical left eyebrow nick is not reliably readable at small game scale. Preserve fixed amber eyes, thick brows, tan skin and square jaw as primary identity; inspect nick in future generated motion. No automatic gate is accepted by this observation.

Corrected turnaround simplifies cloth shading; small skin highlights and extra facets still need visual review against two tones plus highlight/rim. Raw alpha has faint outlying pixels; inspect pipeline fragment removal without painting anatomy.

T5 separation improved by broader panels and detached gauntlet fragments. Front outfit strips are design references, not verified pose-registered motion edits. Validate registrations with official edit-from-master tooling before runtime use.
Seated head reads larger than standing master in visual sheet review. Automated seated exceptions do not certify anatomical matching. Target future AI-only redraw; do not rescale individual cells.
Breathing and secondary motion are deliberately small; inspect GIF playback at1x/2x for perceptible smoothness, beyond nominal24fps draw count.
Review visible hook impact/hold against the official legacy-table event anchors in Cocos playback; do not infer event alignment merely from requested prompt phases.
